messages:
Maya: Quick sync — PR #472 is ready to onboard `model-neo-7b-v1` to the catalog. Two quick blockers: confirm weights URI + a tokenizer sanity check. @Devin can you confirm weights path?
Devin: I pushed the storage manifest in the PR description: s3://redwood-models/neo/7b/v1/weights.tar.lz4. Hash matches CI. Can confirm the URI is public within infra VPC.
Maya: thanks — do we want the regional copy in `eu-west-1` now or staggered after canary?
Sara: prefer staggered. plan: 5% canary in us-west-2 -> 20% -> full, then enable eu-west-1. avoids cross-region thundering.
Liam: FYI tokenizer showed an edge case on the first tokenization test: multi-char control tokens in this ckpt map to unknown ids. Quick repro: `tokenizer.encode("\u200bhello")` returns an extra 0-token.
Liam: I ran `scripts/token-test.sh model-neo-7b-v1` and attached snippet:
```
# token-test.sh output
input: "\u200bhello"
encoded: [0, 1024, 234]
decoded: "\u200bhello"
```
Looks like control-char preserved but encoded as reserved id 0 — might affect prefix caching.
Devin: Hmm, that sounds like a special token mapping mismatch between the repo tokenizer.json and the weights' tokenizer files. I compared `tokenizer.json` in the repo vs the one in s3; they differ by `special_tokens_map`.
Devin: quick diff: `"<|pad|>": 0` vs weights `"<|pad|>": 1`.
Maya: Yikes. If pad id differs, prefix KV cache offsets could be wrong. We should patch the onboard config to force the repo tokenizer to be used (override) until we reconcile weights.
Alex: I can do a tiny PR to the onboard config in the catalog entry. Proposed change snippet: 
```
"tokenizer_override": {
  "uri": "s3://redwood-models/neo/7b/v1/tokenizer.json",
  "force": true
}
```
Will open and tag reviewers.
Sara: also add a `pin` field for the canary variant so we can route fallbacks: e.g. `pin: "neo-7b-v1-revA"` for the initial stable bundle.
Maya: Good call. We should also add a quick runtime config validation step in the onboarding CI that checks: weights hash, tokenizer token-id consistency, and config pin format. If any fail, fail the onboarding job.
Devin: I updated the PR with the tokenizer_override and a note for infra to copy the s3 tokenizer -> catalog bucket. CI shows one warning: `config.validate` flagged `max_sequence_len` absent; default will be 2048 but let's be explicit.
Liam: I'll add a tiny test to assert `tokenizer.pad_id == config.pad_id` in the onboarding suite. That will catch the mismatch next time.
Alex: Code review ping @Maya @Sara — small docs + config tweak.
Maya: LGTM on the change, leave CI green then we can start canary. Sara, when you're ready can you flip the canary schedule in the rollout UI?
Sara: Will do. Plan: start at 5% for 30m, monitor latency and generation failure rate, then 20% for 1h if ok. Will enable eu-west-1 after 2h stable at 20%. I'll post metrics and any rollback notes here. :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: Canary deployment started for catalog:neo-7b-v1 -> %5 on us-west-2 (deployment id: dpl-9843).
Maya: thanks — small followups: add the `audit_log` tag to the catalog entry and include the weights manifest hash in the metadata. After canary completes we can request regional copy.
Devin: done, manifest hash `sha256:3b7f...c2a1` added.
Maya: Awesome. If anything breaks, fallback plan is `neo-7b-v0` pinned in routing. Keep me posted.
Alex: I'll merge my minor PR once CI passes.
Liam: Tests added for pad_id check and pushed. CI queued.
Sara: I'll watch metrics and report back here in ~1h.
Maya: closing async check — thanks everyone.
